name: tokentab
tagline: Compute your coding-agent spend per model, project, and day
description: tokentab is a command-line tool that reads session logs from Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI and computes how much you actually spent on your coding agents — broken down by model, project, and day. Instead of waiting for a monthly bill to surprise you, it gives a live ledger of token usage and cost straight from the logs your agents already keep. It is a practical budget gauge for anyone whose daily work now runs through AI coding assistants.
highlights: Reads Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI session logs natively
Computes cost per model, per project, and per day from real usage
Zero wrapper — works directly against existing agent logs
A simple CLI answer to the growing question of agent ROI
curatorNote: Agents are quietly becoming a line item on every dev's budget, and tokentab turns that opaque spend into a readable ledger. The kind of tiny CLI that earns its place in everyone's dotfiles.
